title: Ukuhlolwa Kwedwala Elingenalutho
intro: Umphakathi, onekhono futhi oziqhenyayo, waqopha ifa lawo ezintabeni. Kodwa lapho kuthunyelwa isibonakaliso esicacile kubo, isivivinyo sokholo nokuzibamba, ukuzikhukhumeza kwabo kwabaholela endleleni yokungabuyeli emuva. Ungalibona leli qembu kanye nomphumela wokungalaleli kwabo?
clues: Sasingochwepheshe bamatshe, siqopha izindlu ezinhle kakhulu eziqongweni zezintaba.
Isithunywa esivela kubantu bakithi seza kithi, sisibiza ukuba sikhulekele uNkulunkulu oyedwa weqiniso.
Safuna isibonakaliso sokufakazela amazwi akhe, kwase kulethwa isidalwa esiyingqayizivele njengesivivinyo kithi.
Sanikwa umyalo olula: ukwabelana ngomthombo wethu wamanzi nalesi sidalwa, sisivumele siphuze ngosuku lwaso olubekiwe.
Ngokuzikhukhumeza kwethu, abambalwa phakathi kwethu bakha uzungu futhi salahla isixwayiso, sabulala isidalwa esasifanele ukuba uphawu lwethu.
Sanikwa izinsuku ezintathu ngaphambi kokubhujiswa kwethu, kwabe sekuqhuma ukuqhuma okukhulu emakhaya ethu, kwasishiya singenampilo futhi sigumbuqelwe.
arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
